title: Ingramon-Depot Therapy in db/db Mice: The Impact on Local and Systemic Inflammation and Myocardial Remodeling.
snippet: : Chronic systemic inflammation is a major driver of myocardial fibrosis in patients with metabolic syndrome; accordingly, db/db mice with impaired leptin signaling are widely used to model myocardial injury associated with obesity and hyperglycemia. title: From Target Discovery to Spatial Delivery: A Translational Roadmap for Gene-Targeted Therapies in Glioma.
snippet: Diffuse gliomas are increasingly defined by molecular alterations, yet the clinical translation of gene-targeted therapies remains constrained by a persistent mismatch between target biology and spatial pharmacology.
